tagline: Delivering clinically superior medical device solutions for specialty nutrition and pain management.
hero_kpi_rationale: This KPI represents Avanos' overall commercial performance across its two key segments (Specialty Nutrition Systems and Pain Management and Recovery), capturing organic growth and the effectiveness of the company's commercial strategies.

kpis.name: Total Net Sales
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated from the sale of medical products and services.
kpis.description: This KPI measures Avanos' total net sales for fiscal year 2025, including the Specialty Nutrition Systems and Pain Management and Recovery segments.
kpis.signal: Key indicator of revenue growth performance.

kpis.name: Specialty Nutrition Systems Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated by the Specialty Nutrition Systems division, including enteral feeding and neonate solutions.
kpis.description: This KPI measures the contribution of the Specialty Nutrition Systems segment to Avanos' total revenue.
kpis.signal: Indicator of growth in the core nutrition segment.

kpis.name: Pain Management and Recovery Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated by the Pain Management and Recovery division, including surgical pain and radiofrequency ablation.
kpis.description: This KPI measures the contribution of the Pain Management and Recovery segment to Avanos' total revenue.
kpis.signal: Indicator of performance in the pain management segment.

kpis.name: Gross Profit
kpis.explanation: Difference between revenue and cost of goods sold.
kpis.description: Gross profit reflects the efficiency of production and the company's pricing strategy.

kpis.name: Gross Margin
kpis.explanation: Gross profit divided by revenue, expressed as a percentage.
kpis.description: Gross margin reflects the percentage of revenue remaining after direct production costs.
kpis.signal: Measures production efficiency and pricing strategy.

kpis.name: Research and Development
kpis.explanation: Expenses dedicated to research and development of new products.
kpis.description: R&D expenses are critical for the development of new medical products.
kpis.signal: Indicates the company's commitment to innovation.

kpis.name: R&D as % Revenue
kpis.explanation: Percentage of revenue allocated to research and development.
kpis.description: R&D as a percentage of revenue shows the company's relative investment in innovation.
kpis.signal: Indicates the relative intensity of innovation investment.

kpis.name: Goodwill and Intangibles Impairment
kpis.explanation: Impairment charges related to goodwill and intangible assets.
kpis.description: In 2025, a goodwill impairment charge of $77.0 million was recorded for the Pain Management and Recovery reporting unit.

kpis.name: Operating Income (Loss)
kpis.explanation: Profit or loss from operations before interest and taxes.
kpis.description: Operating loss reflects results before interest and taxes.

kpis.name: Net Loss
kpis.explanation: Net loss of the company for the fiscal year.
kpis.description: Net loss represents the final result after all expenses and taxes.
kpis.signal: Key indicator of the company's net profitability.

kpis.name: Enteral Feeding Revenue Growth
kpis.explanation: Year-over-year growth in the enteral feeding segment, including MIC-KEY and Corpak products.
kpis.description: Measures growth in enteral feeding solutions within specialty nutrition.
kpis.signal: Indicator of growth in the enteral nutrition segment.

kpis.name: Neonate Solutions Revenue Growth
kpis.explanation: Year-over-year growth in the neonate solutions segment, including NeoMed and Nexus TKO products.
kpis.description: Measures growth in neonatal and pediatric feeding solutions.
kpis.signal: Indicator of growth in the neonate solutions segment.

kpis.name: Radiofrequency Ablation Revenue Growth
kpis.explanation: Year-over-year growth in the radiofrequency ablation segment, including COOLIEF, Trident, and ESENTEC products.
kpis.description: Measures growth in pain management solutions through radiofrequency ablation.
kpis.signal: Indicator of growth in the radiofrequency ablation segment.

kpis.name: Transformation Plan Restructuring Costs
kpis.explanation: Costs related to restructuring and operational optimization initiatives.
kpis.description: Measures costs incurred to align organizational structure and operations.

risks.title: Intense competition in the medical industry
risks.score_rationale: The company operates in a highly competitive market against larger firms with greater resources. Failure to innovate and maintain competitive pricing could impact

risks.title: Dependence on R&D and innovation
risks.score_rationale: Future success depends on the ability to design, acquire, and manufacture competitive products. Rapid technological advances could render products obsolete.

risks.title: Dependence on healthcare reimbursements
risks.score_rationale: The company relies heavily on coverage and reimbursement from healthcare programs for its medical products.

risks.title: Supply chain disruptions
risks.score_rationale: The company has manufacturing facilities in the United States, Mexico, and Canada, and depends on global suppliers.

risks.title: Tariff-related risks
risks.score_rationale: The company relies heavily on manufacturing facilities in Mexico and Canada, as well as raw materials imported from foreign suppliers including China.

risks.title: Asset and goodwill impairment
risks.score_rationale: The company recorded $77.0 million of goodwill impairment in 2025 and $436.7 million in 2024, indicating asset valuation challenges.

risks.title: Negative financial performance
risks.score_rationale: The company reported significant net losses ($72.9 million in 2025 and $392.1 million in 2024), impacting profitability.

risks.title: Acquisition integration
risks.score_rationale: The company has completed several acquisitions (Nexus, Diros) whose integration may fail to deliver expected value.

ai_positioning.summary: Avanos Medical has no significant mentions of artificial intelligence, machine learning, or AI technologies in the provided 10-K excerpts. The company focuses on its traditional medical product segments without an explicit AI positioning.
